plugins.name: chart
plugins.summary: open a balance line chart in a window
plugins.help: Opens a chart in its own window, drawn from hledger's own numbers. Named questions answer for the usual cases: spending, income, cashflow, networth, balances, payees, top and shares. Anything else is read as an account, and a report name such as balance or register is passed through verbatim. The window has no controls: hover for values, click a legend entry to hide a series, scroll to zoom, drag to pan, double-click to reset, click a point to chart that account on its own, and press Escape to go back.

plugins.name: edit
plugins.summary: edit a loaded journal in a window
plugins.help: Opens a file in an editor window, with Ctrl/Cmd-S writing it back to disk. With no argument it edits the journal hledger is reading. Only files from an open folder can be written: everything else opens read-only, and the save says so. If the file changed on disk since it was opened, the save is refused rather than overwriting the change.
